scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @image-platform/shared && npm run dev --workspace @image-platform/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @image-platform/shared && npm run start:dev --workspace @image-platform/api
scripts.setup:local: npm install && npm run infra:up && npm run db:generate && npm run db:push
scripts.build:api:prod: npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace @image-platform/api
scripts.build:web:prod: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @image-platform/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @image-platform/shared && npm run build --workspace @image-platform/api && npm run build --workspace @image-platform/web
